name: Gridline Never-Stop Courier's Perpetual Transit Rig
description: A fully weather-seamed reflective shell in faded hi-vis yellow over a compression base layer, both so worn-in they move as one piece — this person has not been fully out of this kit in days. Cargo pants with every pocket occupied and a custom tail-loop at the rear for a geneware fox tail that acts as a counterbalance at speed. The shoes are Lancer Sprints with the left heel rebuilt twice with epoxy and hope.
functionality: Full weather seal for Lake Michigan conditions; tail-loop accommodates geneware balance aid; every pocket is load-optimized for courier payload.
what_it_says: Someone who is always mid-transit, for whom stopping is a concept that belongs to other people.
worn_by: Tier 2 transit workers on perpetual shift
manufacturer: Gridline (shell); Lancer (shoes, heavily repaired); tail-loop self-modified
story_hooks: One of the cargo pockets has been sealed shut with epoxy from the outside — the courier doesn't know what's in it or when it got there.
The fox tail's geneware install is six months overdue for maintenance and has started to cause phantom pain during cold weather.
